title: Chronicle Runtime Config
description: Scenario-authored runtime defaults loaded from config.json. This is part of the v1 scenario package contract. All fields are optional; missing fields receive runtime defaults. Operators may overlay local settings at runtime.

llm_base_url.description: Base URL for an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. Empty string disables AI dialogue and falls back to stub output unless the operator supplies an override.

llm_model.description: Model identifier passed to the endpoint. Empty string disables AI dialogue and falls back to stub output unless the operator supplies an override.

llm_api_key.description: API key for the endpoint. Leave empty in shared cartridges; local endpoints may not require a key.

llm_http_timeout_ms.description: HTTP request timeout used by the harness transport.

llm_max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for transient endpoint failures.

llm_tls_verify.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates for HTTPS endpoints.

inference_timeout_ms.description: Maximum wall-clock time for one model request in milliseconds. 0 disables timeout-driven cancellation for local debugging.

total_periods.description: Total time periods before the runtime triggers a generic time-expired ending when no authored end_game event fires first.

save_directory.description: Directory where save files are written. Empty string defaults to 'saves' relative to cwd. Machine-specific values should usually come from operator overrides.

max_tool_iterations.description: Maximum harness tool-call loop iterations and per-run tool-call budget.

verb_aliases.description: Maps shorthand player input to full command strings, e.g. {"n": "go north"}.

mutation_narration_templates.description: Per-mutation narration templates. Keys are MutationRequest::Type strings; values may use {npc}, {item}, {mood}, {location} placeholders. Empty value suppresses narration.
